$comment: Rule basis for tests whose corpora are SYNTHETIC (guide-1..N with 'x' bodies), as opposed to the real-shaped fixtures next to it. A basis must describe the corpus it is used with: classification refuses a registry whose rule names a guide that is not in the baseline corpus, or whose anchors are not verbatim in that guide's text (web-uplift-uxr). This registry exists because tests/mwg-drift-extract-pipe.mjs builds its own corpora and used the real-shaped basis-fixture.json with them, which only worked until the two met on the merger's union - the enforcement is correct, the pairing was not.
